map.仓储虫害温度预警器 使用指南: Storage Pest Temperature Alerter User Guide
map.仓储虫害预警器，根据仓温、湿度与粮种预测害虫爆发风险并给防治建议，保障储粮安全。: The storage pest alerter predicts outbreak risk from silo temperature, humidity, and grain type, and gives control recommendations to protect stored grain.
map.风险分 = 温度分 × 0.6 + 湿度分 × 0.3 + 水分分 × 0.1（: Risk score = temperature score × 0.6 + humidity score × 0.3 + moisture score × 0.1 (taking the highest among the pests); temperature and humidity scores are binned by each pest's development range
map.针对粮种对应的主要储粮害虫，逐种按其发育适宜温度区间（tOpt）、最高耐受温度（: For the main storage pests of each grain type, compute a temperature score and a humidity score from the development optimum (tOpt), the maximum tolerable temperature (tMax), and the minimum humidity threshold (rhMin), then combine them with a grain moisture score into an overall risk. The highest-risk pest represents the whole silo, binned as safe / low / medium / high risk with control recommendations.
map.按储粮温度与虫种适温阈值预警爆发风险。: Alert on outbreak risk from the grain temperature and each species' optimal temperature threshold.
map.玉米象、谷蠹适温 25~30℃ 高活跃。: The maize weevil and the granary weevil are highly active at 25–30 °C.
map.用于储粮通风/降温时机决策。: For deciding when to ventilate or cool stored grain.
map.：粮堆平均温度 28℃、相对湿度 65%，处于玉米象最适温区，预警『高风险』。建: : with a grain pile average temperature of 28 °C and 65% relative humidity, conditions sit in the maize weevil's optimal range, so the alert reads "high risk". Start ventilation to bring the grain below 15 °C (where pest development stalls) and check the surface for condensation.
map.仓储虫害爆发温度阈值预警: Temperature-threshold alerts for storage pest outbreaks
map.大棚卷膜时间（温度/风速）建议: Greenhouse film rolling timing recommendations (temperature/wind speed)
map.不能杀灭但显著抑制繁殖与活动。15℃ 以下多数储粮害虫发育停滞，10℃ 以下基本: It cannot kill them but clearly suppresses breeding and activity. Below 15 °C most stored-grain pests stall in development, and below 10 °C they essentially stop — the core of physical control.
map.高湿促霉变与虫卵孵化，低湿也伤粮质。控温同时控湿（通风/密闭）才能兼顾储粮安全。: High humidity encourages mold and insect egg hatching, while low humidity also harms grain quality. Only controlling temperature and humidity together (ventilation or sealing) keeps stored grain safe.
